activation: Only after verifying published prepared head, add ACTIVATE.json as the sole changed path in one direct child commit. No rewrite/retry/marker reuse.
archive_mode: update-only; combine all archive members and immutable REUSE-MANIFEST blobs at exact V5 destinations, retaining every existing main entry byte-for-byte
branch_birth: Create the new qualification branch directly at a prepared direct child of exact accepted main, with all 15 inherited workflows unchanged and the new gated workflow added. ACTIVATE.json must be absent. No preparatory ref at another commit.
main_policy: No main changes, PR, merge, dispatch, inherited workflow edits or deletions.
old_studies: No V1/V2/V3/V4 workflow or marker is added; only the 15 exact pinned-main workflows plus the new V5 workflow are eligible inventory.
preservation_policy: All main tree entries remain identical; the only additions are the V5 docs packet and V5 workflow. Parent must verify main tree, diff, all 15 workflow blob IDs/modes, exact inventory, absent marker, branch availability and remote prepared commit before activation.
publication_preflight: Before any write, parent must verify the dedicated remote branch does not exist and resolve any ambiguous prior create outcome. Never assume the name is unused or retry uncertain creation. Verify the exact prepared remote head and packet tree before activation.
source_reference_role: Whitelist immutable existing blob reuse only. Not the prepared branch parent and never an activation reference.
status: Prepared locally only. V4 deletion proposal abandoned; no denied write retried or alternative route published.
